nodes.text:
This is... a world that isn't finished yet.
Ground under your feet, trees in the distance, and what looks like a wall to the north.

Try walking with WASD. Press E near things to interact.
Esc pauses the game and lets you save.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: Huh? You... actually walked all the way here?

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
This place is different from the one with only a dialogue box.
You can walk around. Want to ask me something?

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
A 3D world still under construction.
There's a door to the north. I think the key fell into the grass to the southeast.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
Because you brought me here.
Oh, and the key to that door in the north seems to have fallen into the grass to the southeast.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: Go explore. I'll be waiting right here.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: The door is to the north. The key is in the grass to the southeast.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: You found the key? Go open the door in the north and take a look.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: The door is open. What's inside? ...Go and see for yourself.

The sign reads:
"North - the door. Southeast - the grass."
The door is locked. It looks like it needs a key.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
You made it here.
This is as far as the world goes for now... The rest of the story is yours to write.
(End of demo. Returning to the main menu.)
